prompts.raven:
Create a production-ready 2D cel-shaded fighting-game ACTION SPRITE ATLAS of exactly the SAME ADULT FEMALE wrestler in the reference image. Match her face, hair, athletic muscular anatomy, costume, colors and linework. This is a sports combat sprite sheet, not pin-up art. Keep the costume intact and opaque. Transparent background.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: exactly 12 complete isolated full-body figures in a strict 3 COLUMN by 4 ROW rectangular grid, portrait 1536x2048 canvas. Each equal-size cell has generous transparent padding. No overlap between cells, no figures clipped at canvas/cell edges, no writing, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows or glow outside figures, no opponent or props.
All figures roughly 3/4 facing to viewer RIGHT. Keep the same head size and anatomical scale in every cell, even when crouched/seated. The pose silhouettes must change dramatically, not only facial expressions. Full articulated actions, grounded balance, correct limb counts and joints. Two arms, two legs. Hands and feet always visible. Readable sports choreography.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) ready: upright balanced fighting stance, fists lightly raised. (2) windup: loaded deep weight shift with torso twisted back and elbow cocked, anticipatory action. (3) elbow: forceful horizontal elbow strike to the right, hips and shoulders fully committed, rear heel lifted.
ROW 2 left to right: (4) kick: powerful fully extended high side kick to the right, supporting leg flexed, arms balancing. (5) clinch: low forward wrestling clinch, both open hands reaching in front and knees bent. (6) lift: overhead powerbomb lift pose, wide planted legs and both hands high gripping an imaginary opponent above head.
ROW 3 left to right: (7) slam: dynamic low sit-out powerbomb landing, both legs spread forward and hands driving down between thighs. (8) suplex: strong backward-arched wrestling bridge, hips high, both arms gripping imaginary waist above chest, head and feet grounded. (9) armbar: seated sideways grappler, legs extending right around imaginary arm, both hands pulling toward chest.
ROW 4 left to right: (10) leglock: deeply crouched seated twisting leg lock, both hands clasped around imaginary ankle, torso twisting. (11) guard: compact standing defensive forearm guard with both forearms in front of face. (12) hurt: pronounced full-body recoil backward from impact, chest and head knocked back, bent knees, arms flung out, feet grounded.
Use clean bold detailed anime/cartoon rendering compatible with reference. Every pose should be a cohesive SINGLE whole character, not separate paper-doll parts. Only one wrestler per cell.
CHARACTER IDENTITY: Long deep-red hair, dark black and red tank top and long leggings, black/red tall lace-up wrestling boots and fingerless gloves. Preserve her strong serious face.
